values.note: DNR: 'Reservations at Smallwood State Park can be made up to 365 days in advance ... Same-day reservations for camp sites can be made online until 5 p.m.' Call center 1-888-432-2267.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Smallwood/Camping.aspx (Reservations) + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/smallwood-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380131 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Smallwood/Camping.aspx ('Each site is equipped with a camping pad, 50-amp electric and water hookups') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/smallwood-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380131 (per-site details: all 18 sites 'Electrical Service (amp): 20, 30, 50', 'Water Service: Y'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 18 campsites, 16 for RVs or tents and 2 tent-only; the 16 list a 30-ft max vehicle length and every site is a back-in.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Smallwood/Camping.aspx ('The campground features 18 campsites, 16 of which are suitable for both RVs and tents, while 2 are designated for tents only.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/smallwood-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380131 (per-site details: Max Vehicle Length 30, Driveway Entry Back-In), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Smallwood/Camping.aspx ('Potable water is available near the camp bathhouse'; 'Wood is available for purchase at Headquarters, the Camp Store') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/smallwood-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380131 (Services and Amenities: Dump Station, Showers, Park Store), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Approximate: the booking site's reservable dates for all campsites are April 3 - October 24, 2026 and April 2 - October 30, 2027.

season.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/smallwood-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380131 (Season Dates: '2026 Reservable Dates All Campsites: April 3, 2026-October 24, 2026'; '2027 ... April 2, 2027-October 30, 2027'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Smallwood camping page and the booking site: 365-day window with same-day online booking until 5 p.m.; 18 sites (16 RV) with 50-amp electric and water, 30-ft max, all back-in; showers, potable water, dump, camp store; season Apr-Oct from the reservable dates. Fees (human-checked) match ($27.50, +$1 weekends). Weekend/holiday minimums not stated for this park (left inherited). Phone 301-743-7613 matches.
flags: Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/southern/Smallwood/Camping.aspx.
